Gripper 3 open–close

Prototype 3, head low in front of the trigger. Squeeze: the trigger pulls the Y link, which pulls both sides of the green collar back, and the three claws open. Release: a spring behind the trigger pushes it forward and the claws close.

  • Trigger travel 20°; the pin 13 mm under its pivot pulls the link 4.5 mm straight back.
  • Claws open 36° at full squeeze. They need about 17° to fit round a ping-pong ball.
  • The Y link pulls the collar evenly on both sides, so it slides straight instead of cocking.
  • Clear pocket in front of the trigger for the fingers; the head starts about 55 mm ahead of the trigger.
